final: WITH state_accounts AS (SELECT COALESCE(c.state_county_province, 'NO STATE') as state, COUNT(a.account_id) as account_count FROM Customers c LEFT JOIN Accounts a ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id GROUP BY c.state_county_province), state_shares AS (SELECT state, account_count, account_count * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Accounts) as share FROM state_accounts), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM state_shares), above_average_states AS (SELECT ss.state, ss.account_count, ss.share, ags.avg_share FROM state_shares ss, average_share ags WHERE ss.share > ags.avg_share) SELECT SUM(account_count) as combined_account_base, AVG(share) as average_share_of_above_avg_states, AVG(share - avg_share) as how_far_above_average FROM above_average_states
